subtitle.en: From soluble protein to a meaningful activity measurement.
subtitle.zh: 从可溶蛋白制备，到可解释的活性测量。

institution: Centre for Enzyme Innovation, University of Portsmouth

summary.en: I worked on CCH11 and TurboPETase expression and characterisation, following protein recovery from small-scale trials through purification and activity measurements. The project helped me connect an assay result to the quality and history of the protein preparation.
summary.zh: 我参与了 CCH11 和 TurboPETase 的表达与表征，从小规模表达试验一路跟踪到纯化和活性测量。这项工作让我把检测结果与蛋白制备质量、表达条件及处理过程联系起来。

introTitle.en: Enzymatic recycling starts with a protein that can be made and tested.
introTitle.zh: 研究酶法回收，先要获得可制备、可检测的蛋白。

introLead.en: PET is a polyester used in packaging and textiles. PET hydrolases cleave ester bonds, creating a possible route to recover smaller molecules from the polymer. My placement focused on the experimental foundation of that idea: producing enzyme preparations suitable for characterisation.
introLead.zh: PET 是包装和纺织品中常用的聚酯。PET 水解酶可切断酯键，为从聚合物中回收小分子提供一种途径。我的实习聚焦于这条路线的实验基础：获得适合开展表征的酶制备物。

body.en: An enzyme offers molecular selectivity in a recycling process. Its usefulness depends on catalytic performance, stability and whether enough functional protein can be produced.
body.zh: 酶能为回收过程提供分子层面的选择性。但实际用途同时取决于催化表现、稳定性，以及能否制备足量的功能蛋白。

body.en: The project included CCH11 and TurboPETase. Their expression and recovery posed different practical problems, making protein production part of the scientific question.
body.zh: 项目涉及 CCH11 和 TurboPETase。两者在表达和回收中遇到的问题不同，因此蛋白生产本身也是需要逐步解决的研究问题。

title.en: What must come before an assay?
title.zh: 测活性之前需要做好什么？

body.en: Expression, solubility and purification each affect the preparation that reaches the assay. A weak signal can reflect losses at any of these stages.
body.zh: 表达量、可溶性和纯化损失，都会影响最后进入检测的样品。活性信号弱，可能源于其中任何一个环节。

title.en: What does a substrate assay tell us?

body.en: I used BHET, a soluble PET-related substrate, alongside plate-reader controls to characterise enzyme preparations. Polymer recycling performance requires separate experiments.
body.zh: 我使用可溶性的 PET 相关底物 BHET，结合酶标仪对照实验表征酶制备物。真实聚合物的回收表现还需要另行测试。

steps.en: Find conditions that recover usable protein.
steps.zh: 先找到能获得可用蛋白的条件。

steps.en: I compared constructs, bacterial strains and IPTG induction conditions at small scale, using SDS-PAGE to inspect the resulting material. This separated low expression from possible solubility problems before committing to larger cultures.
steps.zh: 我在小规模培养中比较构建体、细菌菌株和 IPTG 诱导条件，并用 SDS-PAGE 检查样品，先区分表达不足和可能的可溶性问题，再选择扩大培养的条件。
跟踪每一步分离后的蛋白回收。

steps.en: Selected cultures progressed to His-tag affinity purification and size-exclusion chromatography. CCH11 recovery improved, while TurboPETase remained difficult to recover and solubility was a suspected cause.
steps.zh: 选定条件后，我进行 His 标签亲和纯化和体积排阻色谱。CCH11 的回收得到改善；TurboPETase 仍较难获得，可溶性是当时重点考虑的原因之一。

steps.en: I explored changes to the tag and a move from bacterial to yeast expression, followed by calorimetry. Changing host and tag can affect several properties together, so folding and post-translational modification became questions for further experiments.
steps.zh: 我尝试调整标签、从细菌转向酵母表达，并进行后续量热分析。宿主和标签的改变会同时影响多个因素，因此折叠和翻译后修饰成为值得进一步实验检验的问题。

steps.en: Read the activity alongside the preparation history.
steps.zh: 结合蛋白制备过程解释活性。

steps.en: I worked with plate-reader and HPLC-based characterisation. CCH11 test wells showed a different response from controls. Quantitative enzyme comparisons would also require matched protein inputs and calibrated product measurements.
steps.zh: 我参与了酶标仪和 HPLC 表征，观察到 CCH11 实验孔与对照孔的响应差异。若要定量比较酶性能，还需要匹配蛋白用量，并通过产物校准连接信号与实际转化。

contribution.en: My work covered expression trials, protein preparation and analysis of laboratory readouts. The main lesson was practical: before interpreting a catalytic difference, account for how much functional protein was actually made and recovered.
contribution.zh: 我的工作覆盖表达条件试验、蛋白制备和实验读数分析。这段经历给我的核心认识很具体：解释催化差异之前，先弄清究竟制备并回收了多少功能蛋白。
